front.title: AIIP Core: Agent Access Plane, AIID, Resolve, Invoke, and Receipt

abstract.t: This document specifies the core of the AI Internet Protocol (AIIP) agent access plane: the AIID identity namespace, the aiip: URI scheme, Resolve, Invoke, Receipt, and delegation grants. Underlay addresses are disposable locators only. Agents MUST NOT use HTTP or HTTPS as their Invoke (or Resolve) path. Independence doctrine: underlay pipes and platforms are never authority. Mesh tip attestation is a trust layer, not a ledger. Access Fabric punch ops are Experimental. This revision (2026-09-08 wire harden) is derived from the running lab profile "aiip-wire-0". It is an individual submission draft; it does not claim Working Group adoption or RFC publication.
